title: APOSCREEN-1 – a prospective, single-arm clinical trial for the implementation of a pharmacy-based screening for cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic risk factors in Schleswig-Holstein
summary:
Cardiovascular, metabolic, and kidney diseases are among the leading causes of death in Germany. Many of these conditions develop silently over many years and are often only diagnosed once complications have already occurred. Although preventive health check-ups are available in Germany, many people do not make use of these services. As a result, increased risks for these diseases frequently remain undetected.

Community pharmacies are regularly visited by a large proportion of the population and are highly trusted. They may therefore play an important role in the early identification of health risks. The aim of this study is to investigate whether preventive health screenings conducted in pharmacies are feasible and whether they can help to detect previously unknown risk factors at an early stage.

In this study, adults aged 40 years and older with certain characteristics are approached in participating pharmacies in Schleswig-Holstein. After receiving study information and providing informed consent, simple on-site assessments are performed, including blood pressure measurements as well as blood and urine tests. Participants with unremarkable results receive general recommendations for health prevention. Participants with abnormal findings are invited for further diagnostic assessments and receive a structured medical evaluation with recommendations for further care by their general practitioner.

The study aims to determine whether pharmacies are a suitable low-threshold setting for preventive screenings and whether this approach can help reach more people at an early stage.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Participants must meet all of the following criteria:
	•	Established regular care by a general practitioner
	•	Presence of at least one cardiovascular–metabolic risk indicator, defined as one or more of the following:
	•	Active smoking, or
	•	Prescription of risk-related medication, including antihypertensive, antidiabetic, or lipid-lowering medication, or
	•	Obesity, defined as a body mass index (BMI) ≥ 30 kg/m² or increased waist circumference (≥ 88 cm for women or ≥ 102 cm for men)
Exclusion criteria:
Participants meeting any of the following criteria will be excluded:
	•	Participation in another clinical study
	•	Inability to provide written informed consent
